observations.why: Directive issued in a settled, matter-of-fact register — scheduling a recurring practice with no urgency or alarm, conveying confident satisfaction.
Aphoristic framing carries urgency-as-worry: an unrehearsed rollback is declared as effectively nonexistent, pressing the stakes with high-arousal negative valence.

mints.name: StakesByNegation
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the speaker raising urgency by declaring that an unpracticed capability is effectively nonexistent?
